title: Prove Project CI history through the components that show it

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The gap-only history test caught the loss of all seven unmeasured landing rows after the reader opened Builds and evidence on a phone.

The check used story `SEED-413#renovate-dashboard-frontend-unit-tests` at `2b858d95899f43e92272253e623f146966c6900b` and the maintained gap fixture in `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-ci-wall-time-history-gaps.mounted.spec.ts`. The single scratch fault in `dashboard/src/IntentCiHistory.tsx:198` filtered the evidence rows to measured builds. The fixture, assertions, disclosure, and chart behavior stayed intact.

`caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- intent/intent-ci-wall-time-history-gaps --workers=2` selected one Chromium case. The baseline passed. In the faulted run, the trace recorded focus on the disclosure and native Enter. Vitest showed the resulting `<ul aria-label="Builds and evidence" />` with zero children. The visibility assertion at line 138 failed before the exact seven-row comparison. The restored run passed, the scratch state matched its clean starting state, and the scratch worktree was removed.
